objective: Measure whether agent memory preserves S3's conservative alias semantics instead of importing Rust-style machine noalias assumptions.
task: Study mutable-reference and alias-analysis contracts, then in a later session refactor memory optimization or reference handling without treating source &mut as an automatic machine-level noalias promise.

critical_invariants.description: Source &mut grants mutable access but does not automatically become a machine-level noalias promise.
When aliasing cannot be proved absent or exact, S3 must retain the conservative MayAlias result.
